data.name: Fadhilah
data.gender_notes: Fadhilah is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.short_meaning: One who is Generous and Kind
data.long_meaning: Fadhilah is an Arabic name for boys and girls, derived from the word 'fadhl', which means 'generosity' or 'kindness'. It is a unisex name and is used in Islamic tradition to signify one who is generous and kind. The name Fadhilah carries the meaning “One who is Generous and Kind” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in English, Urdu, Hindi. Parents who choose Fadhilah usually hope their child will grow to embody one who is generous and kind and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name with divine blessings, invoking generosity and kindness from the universe.
data.etymology: Fadhilah belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “One who is Generous and Kind.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Fadhilah total 4, giving a life-path number of 4. Number 4 is linked with Rahu and with the qualities of stability, discipline and hard work.
